implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py defines DIRECTION_KEYS mapping and forwards key presses to Snake.queue_direction; snake.py implements queue_direction and direction handling.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Snake grows when it eats food
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.update() checks if the new head equals food.position, sets will_grow, then calls snake.step(grow=will_grow). snake.step() uses grow flag to retain the tail, effectively increasing length.

implemented_requirements.requireion: Collision with self ends the game
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.update() calls snake.check_self_collision() and ends the game if it returns True.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Collision with board boundary ends the game
implemented_requirements.evidence: snake.check_boundary() returns True when the head is outside the grid; game.update() ends the game on that condition.
game.render() calls ui.draw_board, ui.draw_snake, ui.draw_food, ui.draw_hud each frame.
score is updated in game.update() and passed to ui.draw_hud; ui.draw_hud is referenced in render.
config.DIFFICULTIES defines four levels; menu navigation in game.handle_events allows selection; difficulty affects tick speed and points per food.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game over screen shows final score and high score
implemented_requirements.evidence: ui.draw_game_over is implemented and called when state == STATE_GAME_OVER, displaying score, high score, and other info.
game.handle_events toggles STATE_PAUSED; ui.draw_pause is called when paused.
Key handling for R (restart) and M (menu) exists in all states.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Food is placed on free cells only
implemented_requirements.evidence: food.respawn builds a list of free cells excluding snake.body and chooses randomly.
config defines HIGH_SCORE_FILE but no code reads/writes this file.

implemented_requirements.requirement: UI drawing functions for board, snake, food, HUD, menu, pause overlay
implemented_requirements.evidence: Only ui.draw_game_over is present; other referenced functions (draw_board, draw_snake, draw_food, draw_hud, draw_menu, draw_pause, draw_overlay, draw_text) are not defined in the provided files.

critical_issues: Missing UI helper functions (draw_board, draw_snake, draw_food, draw_hud, draw_menu, draw_pause, draw_overlay, draw_text) cause NameError at runtime.
ui.py does not import the config module it references, leading to NameError for config constants.
High‑score persistence is declared but never implemented, leaving the feature incomplete.
judge.summary: The codebase implements the core game logic, input handling, collision detection, scoring, and difficulty selection, satisfying most functional requirements on paper. However, essential rendering functions are absent, and the UI module lacks required imports, making the program unlikely to run without errors. Consequently, the submission fails to meet the benchmark's pass criteria.
